Name: Alumni Tech Network
About__c: A community for alumni working in technology to share ideas and opportunities.
What_We_Offer__c: Monthly virtual meetups, speaker sessions and a shared job board.
Community_Guidelines__c: Be respectful. No spam or unsolicited sales pitches.

Name: Career Switchers Circle
About__c: Support group for alumni changing industries or re-entering the workforce.
What_We_Offer__c: Peer mentoring, resume reviews and interview practice.
Community_Guidelines__c: Keep shared career details confidential within the group.

Name: NYC Metro Alumni
About__c: Alumni living in and around New York City.
What_We_Offer__c: In-person socials, museum outings and volunteer days.
Community_Guidelines__c: RSVP honestly for events so we can plan headcount.

Name: Leadership Development
About__c: A private cohort for alumni building management and leadership skills.
What_We_Offer__c: Structured cohort programme with quarterly workshops.
Community_Guidelines__c: Membership is by approval. Discussions stay in the group.

Name: Photography Club
About__c: Alumni who love photography sharing work and technique.
What_We_Offer__c: Monthly photo themes and peer critique threads.
Community_Guidelines__c: Only post work you own the rights to.

Name: Entrepreneurs Guild
About__c: For alumni founding or running their own businesses.
What_We_Offer__c: Founder roundtables and investor office hours.
Community_Guidelines__c: No soliciting investment directly in the feed.

Name: Boston Chapter
About__c: Alumni based in the greater Boston area.
Community_Guidelines__c: Be welcoming to new grads joining the chapter.

Name: Book Club
What_We_Offer__c: One book a month with a live discussion thread.
Community_Guidelines__c: No spoilers before the discussion date.

Name: Sustainability Forum
About__c: Alumni working on climate and sustainability challenges.
What_We_Offer__c: Guest speakers and a curated resource library.
Community_Guidelines__c: Cite sources when sharing research claims.

Name: Archived Test Group
About__c: Inactive group used to verify it is hidden from the directory.

Name: Hidden Ops Group
About__c: Hidden-visibility group used to test directory filtering.
